title: cast
description: Dramatis personae for a bundle (cast.json): the reduced, canonicalized character list produced by the cast pipeline (DESIGN §4.3, §7.2). This is the published contract; work-phase reducer intermediates (e.g. is_person, descriptors) are not part of it.

characters.description: All characters kept in the cast, majors and minors.

slug.description: Kebab-case, de-articled, uniquified identifier for this character (DESIGN §7.2). Stable within the bundle; used in portrait filenames and pseudo-plate ids.

name.description: Display name: the most frequent full label for this character (DESIGN §7.2).

aliases.description: Other labels for this character besides the canonical name.

mention_pages.description: Zero-padded 4-digit page ids on which this character is mentioned, used for the reader's furthest-read cast filter (DESIGN §13, ADR-0008).

items.description: A page id: zero-padded 4-digit sequence string.

major.description: Whether this character is a major (rendered with a canonical visual description and eligible for a portrait). See the major rule in DESIGN §7.2.

visual_description.description: Canonical visual description used in prompts and portraits. Null for minors, which get no detailed canonicalization (DESIGN §7.2).

one_line.description: One-line character summary for the dramatis-personae page and prompt context.

tags.description: Free-form descriptive tags for the character.

portrait.description: Relative bundle path to this character's rendered portrait PNG (e.g. 'images/portraits/time-traveller.png'), or null if no portrait exists.

edited_by_human.description: True if a human edited this character's visual_description/one_line in the review gate (DESIGN §11.1).
